opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (bi-monthly: 1st February, April, June, August, October, December)

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (£750 for Adelphi co-sponsored); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members. Scheme A (GS/SIG meetings): undergraduate, Master's and PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C (non-GS and virtual meetings): PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on genetics research, covering travel, accommodation and registration costs across three streams (GS/SIG meetings, non-GS meetings, and virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Funds members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project, producing results suitable for publication in the Society's journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member with caring responsibilities, regardless of age of the person cared for.
opportunities.summary: Award to support attendance at Society meetings for members with caring responsibilities, usable as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting

amount.raw: Several levels: a Genetics Society lecture for a few hundred pounds, a GS session up to about £1,000, major sponsorship of an entire meeting several thousand pounds (recent £1,000–£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, for use towards the organisation of a meeting.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (two deadlines per year: 1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes (Special Interest Groups) for genetics research communities running regular meeting series.
